content.title: About
content.content: Organic ready-to-feed infant formula is designed for babies from birth to 12 months. It is made from certified organic ingredients, contains no GMOs, artificial preservatives, or flavors. The formula provides a balanced ratio of proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals essential for infant growth and development.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The formula is produced from whole organic cow's milk that is pasteurized at low temperature to preserve nutrients.
All ingredients are certified according to USDA Organic standards (or equivalent in the country of manufacture).
Ready-to-feed format is packaged in sterile single-use containers, eliminating the need for sterilization before feeding.
The formula includes prebiotics that support the development of a healthy gut microbiome in infants.
The product has undergone clinical trials confirming its safety and efficacy.

items.title: Supports growth and development
items.content: A balanced mix of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates provides energy and building blocks for tissue growth.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2, B6, and B12 support nervous system development and metabolism.

items.title: Immune system support
items.content: Vitamin A, vitamin D, and zinc help strengthen the infant's immune defenses.

items.title: Bone health
items.content: Calcium and phosphorus together with vitamin D promote strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Digestive health
items.content: Prebiotics and a modest amount of dietary fiber aid normal digestion and help prevent constipation.

items.title: Cow's milk protein allergy
items.content: Some infants may develop an allergy to cow's milk protein; discontinue use and consult a pediatrician if symptoms appear.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: While no added sugars are present, natural lactose is included; infants with lactose intolerance require special attention.

items.title: Shelf life after opening
items.content: Once opened, the formula should be used within 24 hours and kept refrigerated to prevent bacterial growth.

items.title: Not suitable after 12 months
items.content: After one year, nutritional needs change, and age‑appropriate foods should be introduced.

content.title: How to Feed
content.content: Shake the container before use, open the single‑use spout, and dispense the ready product into a clean bottle. Do not heat in a microwave; warm the bottle in warm water to about 37 °C. If dilution is required, follow the manufacturer’s instructions.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened containers in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and use within 24 hours. Discard the product if it develops an off‑smell, color, or taste.
